estimand: Complete observed-key person-macro CER and signed within-person control/reference/mode contrasts, separately for MEG and EEG.
limitations: Event-assisted retrospective known-length batch task, not unassisted continuous typing.
Nuisance timing and ocular controls do not identify physiological causality.
Foundation-model language pretraining may carry memorization.
Cross-modal person overlap is unknown; no pooled39-person inference.
Entropy describes output distributions, not accuracy or scientific reasoning.
Reference competence and scientific interpretation require independent qualification.
